(2) The top frame transitions to a close-up of an idol with pigtails and a white hat, who is singing and making playful hand gestures toward the camera. The lighting is dominated by pink and lavender hues. Below, the man blinks slowly and slightly shifts his gaze, maintaining a calm and sleepy facial posture. The man at the bottom finally opens his mouth slightly, appearing to be completely absorbed by the high-energy performance he is watching.
